mapper.select: SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, DEPT_NM, STATUS_CD FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M ORDER BY STATUS_CD DESC, STAFF_NM
SELECT EMPLY_ID, EMPLY_NM FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD = '2' AND IFNULL(DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY EMPLY_NM

SELECT R.RSCH_SQ, R.STAFF_SQ, S.STAFF_NM, S.DEPT_NM, R.ROLE_CD , DATE_FORMAT(R.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DT, DATE_FORMAT(R.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS END_DT FROM TB_EEP_LAB_RESEARCHER_M R JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M S ON S.STAFF_SQ = R.STAFF_SQ ORDER BY R.END_DT IS NULL DESC, R.END_DT DESC, R.ROLE_CD, S.STAFF_NM

SELECT S.STAFF_NM, R.ROLE_CD FROM TB_EEP_LAB_RESEARCHER_M R JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M S ON S.STAFF_SQ = R.STAFF_SQ WHERE R.START_DT <= LAST_DAY(CONCAT(#{ym}, '-01')) AND (R.END_DT IS NULL OR R.END_DT >= CONCAT(#{ym}, '-01')) ORDER BY R.ROLE_CD, S.STAFF_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_LAB_RESEARCHER_M (STAFF_SQ, ROLE_CD, START_DT, END_DT, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{STAFF_SQ}, #{ROLE_CD}, #{START_DT}, NULLIF(#{END_DT}, ''), #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT P.PRJ_SQ, P.PRJ_NM, P.PLACE, P.MANAGER_EMPLY_ID, P.CEO_EMPLY_ID, P.DRIVE_FOLDER_ID , DATE_FORMAT(P.START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DT, DATE_FORMAT(P.END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS END_DT , M.EMPLY_NM AS MANAGER_NM, C.EMPLY_NM AS CEO_NM FROM TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M P LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EMPLY_M M ON M.EMPLY_ID = P.MANAGER_EMPLY_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_EMPLY_M C ON C.EMPLY_ID = P.CEO_EMPLY_ID ORDER BY P.END_DT DESC, P.PRJ_SQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M (PRJ_NM, START_DT, END_DT, PLACE, MANAGER_EMPLY_ID, CEO_EMPLY_ID, DRIVE_FOLDER_ID, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{PRJ_NM}, #{START_DT}, #{END_DT}, #{PLACE}, #{MANAGER_EMPLY_ID}, #{CEO_EMPLY_ID}, #{DRIVE_FOLDER_ID}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT PRJ_SQ, DATE_FORMAT(START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DT, DATE_FORMAT(END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS END_DT FROM TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M WHERE PRJ_SQ = #{PRJ_SQ}

SELECT J.JRN_SQ, J.PRJ_SQ, J.YM, J.STATUS_CD, J.WRITER_NM, J.PDF_LINK, J.UPLOAD_ERR, COALESCE(J.SNAP_PRJ_NM, P.PRJ_NM) AS PRJ_NM FROM TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M J JOIN TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M P ON P.PRJ_SQ = J.PRJ_SQ ORDER BY J.YM DESC, J.JRN_SQ DESC

SELECT J.JRN_SQ, J.PRJ_SQ, J.YM, J.CONTENT, J.STATUS_CD, J.WRITER_NM, J.SNAP_MEMBERS, J.PDF_FILE_ID, J.PDF_LINK, J.UPLOAD_ERR , COALESCE(J.SNAP_PRJ_NM, P.PRJ_NM) AS PRJ_NM, COALESCE(J.SNAP_PLACE, P.PLACE) AS PLACE , COALESCE(J.SNAP_PERIOD, CONCAT(P.START_DT, ' ~ ', P.END_DT)) AS PERIOD , P.MANAGER_EMPLY_ID, P.CEO_EMPLY_ID, P.DRIVE_FOLDER_ID FROM TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M J JOIN TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M P ON P.PRJ_SQ = J.PRJ_SQ WHERE J.JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ}
SELECT ACTION_CD, STATUS_CD, ACTOR_ID, ACTOR_NM, NOTE, DATE_FORMAT(REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DT FROM TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_H WHERE JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ} ORDER BY HIS_SQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M (PRJ_SQ, YM, STATUS_CD, WRITER_EMPLY_ID, WRITER_NM) VALUES (#{PRJ_SQ}, #{YM}, 'DRAFT', #{ACTOR_ID}, #{ACTOR_NM})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M SET CONTENT = #{CONTENT} WHERE JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ} AND STATUS_CD = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M J JOIN TB_EEP_LAB_PROJECT_M P ON P.PRJ_SQ = J.PRJ_SQ SET J.STATUS_CD = 'SUBMITTED', J.SNAP_PRJ_NM = P.PRJ_NM, J.SNAP_PLACE = P.PLACE, J.SNAP_PERIOD = CONCAT(P.START_DT, ' ~ ', P.END_DT), J.SNAP_MEMBERS = #{MEMBERS} WHERE J.JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ} AND J.STATUS_CD = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M SET PDF_FILE_ID = #{PDF_FILE_ID}, PDF_LINK = #{PDF_LINK}, UPLOAD_ERR = NULL WHERE JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ}
UPDATE TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_M SET UPLOAD_ERR = #{UPLOAD_ERR} WHERE JRN_SQ = #{JRN_SQ}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_LAB_JOURNAL_H (JRN_SQ, ACTION_CD, STATUS_CD, ACTOR_ID, ACTOR_NM, NOTE, REG_DT) VALUES (#{JRN_SQ}, #{ACTION_CD}, #{STATUS_CD}, #{ACTOR_ID}, #{ACTOR_NM}, NULLIF(#{NOTE}, ''), DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR))
